evidenceAndSafety.externalTerminationLimit: External termination of the PowerShell process cannot execute finally. Keep the parent deadline disabled and do not terminate an installed-mutant run; archived originals and interim proof remain available for PM recovery. An unreaped process explicitly prevents release of the compute slot.
